Beyond Ten
Timed action speed (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Timed actions tied to a skill get this much shorter for each level above 10 in that skill. Also used for milking, shearing and other animal care cycles. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.5.
Butchering uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: animal part and meat quality chances use Butchering levels 11-15. Off: they use level 10. Default: on.
Cooking hunger, thirst and nutrition (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra hunger, thirst-quenching and nutrition values of food made with a recipe that gives Cooking XP, for each level above 10 in Cooking. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Crafted item maximum condition (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra maximum condition of crafted durable items for each level above 10 in the recipe's skill. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Electrical generator repair (condition per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra generator condition per repair for each level above 10 in Electrical, rounded to a whole number. 0 turns it off. Default: 0.5.
Farming extra crop chance (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Chance for one more crop per harvest for each level above 10 in Farming. 0 turns it off. Default: 5.
Farming starting plant health (per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra starting health of a planted crop for each level above 10 in Farming. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Farming harvest yield (crops per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra crops per harvest for each level above 10 in Farming. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
First Aid uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: treatment strength, pain reduction and wound handling use First Aid levels 11-15. Off: they use level 10. Default: on.
Fishing uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: fishing calculations use Fishing and Strength levels 11-15. Off: they use level 10. Default: on.
Fishing maximum fish weight (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Higher maximum fish weight for each level above 10 in Fishing. Works only when "Fishing uses levels 11-15" is on. 0 turns it off. Default: 10.
Fitness endurance loss reduction (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Endurance loss reduction for each level above 10 in Fitness. All endurance loss reductions together stop at 35%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Fitness endurance recovery (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Faster endurance recovery for each level above 10 in Fitness. Stops at 15%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Foraging endurance and fatigue cost (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Lower endurance and fatigue cost of foraging for each level above 10 in Foraging. 0 turns it off. Default: 5.
Foraging uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: foraged item quality and identification use Foraging levels 11-15. Off: they use level 10. Default: on.
Foraging search radius (tiles per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra search radius in tiles for each level above 10 in Foraging. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Foraging spotting time (ms per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Milliseconds taken off the 500 ms spotting time for each level above 10 in Foraging. The time never goes below 100 ms. 0 turns it off. Default: 60.
Animal Care petting stress relief (per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra animal stress removed by petting for each level above 10 in Animal Care. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Lightfooted endurance loss reduction (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Endurance loss reduction while moving and sneaking, for each level above 10 in Lightfooted. All endurance loss reductions together stop at 35%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Maintenance condition recovery (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Chance for each level above 10 in Maintenance to get back a weapon condition point right after losing it. 0 turns it off. Default: 6.
Mechanics repair (condition per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra condition when repairing engine parts and lightbars for each level above 10 in Mechanics, rounded to a whole number. 0 turns it off. Default: 0.5.
Nimble endurance loss reduction (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Endurance loss reduction while moving and aiming, for each level above 10 in Nimble. All endurance loss reductions together stop at 35%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.5.
Reloading mastery speeds up reloading
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Each Reloading level above 10 adds 0.10 to reload speed and 0.04 to racking speed. Off: Reloading 11-15 reloads like level 10. Default: on.
Sneaking endurance loss reduction (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Endurance loss reduction while moving and sneaking, for each level above 10 in Sneaking. All endurance loss reductions together stop at 35%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Sprinting endurance loss reduction (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Endurance loss reduction while running or sprinting, for each level above 10 in Sprinting. All endurance loss reductions together stop at 35%%. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Strength carry capacity (per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra carry capacity for each level above 10 in Strength. 0 turns it off. Default: 1.
Strength melee damage (%% per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra melee weapon damage for each level above 10 in Strength. 0 turns it off. Default: 2.
Tailoring patches use levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: new clothing patches get the defense of Tailoring levels 11-15. Off: they get the defense of level 10. Default: on.
Tailoring patch recovery (percentage points per level above 10)
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Higher chance to get the fabric back when removing a patch, for each level above 10 in Tailoring. 0 turns it off. Default: 5.
Tracking uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: track inspection uses Tracking levels 11-15. Off: it uses level 10. Default: on.
Trapping uses levels 11-15
Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. On: new traps use Trapping levels 11-15 for catch chance. Off: they use level 10. Default: on.
Weapon skill damage (%% per level above 10)

Applies only to mastery levels 11-15. Extra weapon damage for each level above 10 in the weapon's own skill: Aiming for firearms, the matching melee skill for melee weapons. 0 turns it off. Default: 3.
